target.description: Reported use of at least 2 of Amphetamines, Cocaine, Crack, Ketamine within the past month

protocol.selection: training-only 5-fold AP; sigmoid calibration on training OOF predictions; validation F1 threshold; single selected-model test audit
protocol.test_status: Previously exposed internal benchmark; NOT an untouched external test

limitations: Previously exposed UCI benchmark: no fresh generalization claim.
NEO-derived features do not accept IPIP questionnaire inputs.
Sigmoid calibration is estimated internally, not validated for an app population.
Co-occurrence within a month does not mean simultaneous consumption.
Importance measures predictive dependence, not causal influence.
Source quantification preceded our split; this cannot be undone.
